fusions.name: Called Shot
fusions.desc: Sights along the haft and sends the head at a target up to 7 tiles away for 16 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: All Faults Found
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to every enemy in it and leaving each [Marked] for 8 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Dead Centre
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Nail's Head
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%.
